subject: general
question: Who among the following won P4 gold at the Al Ain 2021 Para Shooting World Cup in March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manish Narwal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Manish Narwal** won P4 gold at the Al Ain 2021 Para Shooting World Cup in March 2021.
 
• He was awarded the** Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna Award 2021.**
 
• He is an Indian Para Pistol Shooter.
 
• He ranks fourth in the world in Men's 10m Air Pistol SH1 according to the World Shooting Para Sports Rankings.
 
• Manish is also supported by GoSports Foundation through the Para Champions Programme.
 
• Recently Manish Narwal clinched a **gold medal** in the men’s 50m pistol SH1 event at the **Tokyo Paralympics 2021.**
